items.title: Show HN: CLI for Cybersecurity Triage
items.contentSnippet:
I built it to replace the repetitive workflows of moving tabs and copying indicators across many tools and tabs for every investigation. You use your own API keys, and functions like decoding, identifying commands, and man pages all run locally with no LLM.
Please let me know what you think, you can try it here right now. More information about it can be found here: ceplang.org/start.html
As well as a short demo here: https://youtu.be/bzGGigpeiXg

items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN,
I've been fascinated by aviation for some time now. Inspired by Fugleramme, I wanted a framed print of a cluster of aircraft over my house or a busy airport. So I built Overhead. (Photos in the README)
The hero photo shows planes departing and landing in Changi, Singapore.
How it works
Flight data for a location is gathered from adsb.lol and adsb.fi as a fallback. (you can also point it to your own ADS-B receiver).
